findings.text: {base} — اپ ڈیٹ کے لیے ریٹائر کیا گیا
findings.evidence: ریٹائر کرنا/ہونا in everyday Urdu primarily means retiring from employment (pension); for a cut turn it reads as an English IT calque ('taken out of service'), and can suggest permanent withdrawal rather than a resumable cut. Mitigated: passive, cause clause, base 'Interrupted' alongside, and it is the locale's established term in 4 other keys — changing this key alone would split vocabulary.
findings.fix: Prefer a locale-wide decision across all 5 'retired' keys rather than this key alone. If changed, the terse cause-only form avoids the calque and duplicates nothing: '{base} — اپ ڈیٹ کی وجہ سے' (cf. ru '{base} — из-за обновления'). Keeping the current text is acceptable.

findings.text: {base} — اپ ڈیٹ کے لیے ریٹائر کیا گیا
findings.evidence: کے لیے is purposive ('for the sake of the update'); the sidecar says the suffix names the CAUSE. Faithful to English 'for', so not wrong.
findings.fix: If touched: کی وجہ سے (because of), e.g. '{base} — اپ ڈیٹ کی وجہ سے ریٹائر کیا گیا' (49 cells w/ Interrupted) keeps the established term.
